member.name: T:NAudio.Wave.AudioFileReader
member.summary: AudioFileReader simplifies opening an audio file in NAudio Simply pass in the filename, and it will attempt to open the file and set up a conversion path that turns into PCM IEEE float. ACM codecs will be used for conversion. It provides a volume property and implements both WaveStream and ISampleProvider, making it possibly the only stage in your audio pipeline necessary for simple playback scenarios

member.name: M:NAudio.Wave.AudioFileReader.#ctor(System.String)
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of AudioFileReader
member.exception: Running on a platform other than Windows and the file is not PCM or IEEE float WAV, or AIFF. Media Foundation and ACM decoding are Windows-only; on other platforms use SoundFileReader from the NAudio.SoundFile package.

member.name: M:NAudio.Wave.AudioFileReader.#ctor(System.IO.Stream)
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of AudioFileReader from a stream. The audio format is detected from the stream contents, so no file name is required. WAV and AIFF streams are handled by the cross-platform readers; on Windows any other format is passed to Media Foundation.
member.param: The stream to read from. It must be readable and seekable, and the caller retains ownership of it — disposing the AudioFileReader does not dispose the underlying stream.
member.exception: Running on a platform other than Windows and the stream is not PCM or IEEE float WAV, or AIFF. Media Foundation and ACM decoding are Windows-only; on other platforms use SoundFileReader from the NAudio.SoundFile package.
